WOM.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable PF2e Words of Magic
WOM.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Master switch. When off, no incantations are generated.
WOM.Settings.ShowInChat.Name: Show Incantation in Chat
WOM.Settings.ShowInChat.Hint: Post a styled incantation card to chat when a spell is cast.
WOM.Settings.ShowAboveToken.Name: Show Incantation Above Token
WOM.Settings.ShowAboveToken.Hint: Display the incantation as scrolling text above the caster's token.
WOM.Settings.SuppressCantrips.Name: Suppress Cantrip Incantations
WOM.Settings.SuppressCantrips.Hint: Cantrips are cast constantly — disable their incantations to reduce noise.
WOM.Settings.ChatVisibility.Name: Chat Card Visibility
WOM.Settings.ChatVisibility.Hint: Who can see the incantation chat card.
WOM.Settings.ScrollDuration.Name: Floating Text Duration (seconds)
WOM.Settings.ScrollDuration.Hint: How long the incantation text floats above the token.
WOM.Settings.DefaultTradition.Name: Default Tradition Fallback
WOM.Settings.DefaultTradition.Hint: Used when tradition cannot be determined from the actor or spell data.
